title: Real-World Applications and AI Product Design
learning_outcomes: Explain the major concepts in Real-World Applications and AI Product Design and connect the numbered lesson topics.
Apply a representative technique or model the decision process using a transparent example.
Describe evaluation needs, assumptions, and risks relevant to the module.

overview_visual.alt_text: Two-column lesson roadmap for Module 17: Real-World Applications and AI Product Design. It lists 6 curriculum topics and ends with the workflow Observe, Experiment, Evaluate, Iterate.
overview_visual.caption: Module 17 visual roadmap: scan the ordered lesson cards, then use the Observe → Experiment → Evaluate → Iterate cycle when applying the concepts.

notes: All 6 lesson titles and their source subtopics are preserved from the AI.pdf syllabus. Product decisions need user needs, a non-AI baseline, measurable outcomes, and realistic operating constraints. Use AI only where it adds defensible value. The module is draft pending subject-matter review.
